description: For every nonempty finite cyclic sequence of sets, at least one next set does not belong to its predecessor, including the last-to-first step.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FoundationAndRank.no_finite_membership_cycle.{u} (n : ℕ) (f : Fin (n + 1) → ZFSet.{u}) :
  ¬∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), f (i + 1) ∈ f i
